name: Void Club
desc: This club feels light when held, yet heavy when swung.

name: Galaxite Dagger
desc: A quick-stabbing weapon made for close combat. The blade is so fine that it can cut a hair into two pieces lengthways.

name: Rune Song
desc: A legendary sword that hums when swung through the air. Its durability is a testament to extraordinary craftsmanship, said to carry the whispers of ancient battles within its blade.

name: Ritual Dagger
desc: This unusual dagger is made from a big gemstone shard. There are dark red spots on the handle.

name: Tin Dagger
desc: A small blade that allows for quick stabs.

name: Rusty Dagger
desc: A blade so corroded it only vaguely resembles copper. It's deceptively sharp.

name: Scarlet Dagger
desc: This wavy, crimson dagger pierces through most materials.

name: Splintered Wooden Sword
desc: This simple sword has seen far more battles than its maker would ever suggest. A worn reminder that even the humblest blade can do the impossible, where every crack Dares the next blow to land.

name: Poisonous Sickle
desc: Farming tool that turned into a weapon when a great threat had to be slain.

name: Prehistoric Crystal Spear
desc: One of the first weapons ever made by mankind, but this one has an ancient gemstone in place of a normal spearhead.

name: Hunting Spear
desc: A very crude long-reach weapon used by the cavelings dwelling in the Clay Caves. Good to hunt larvae and place them over a fire.

name: Atlantean Worm Sword
desc: A dislodged, razorsharp mandible of the Atlantean Worm. The maker of the deep sea.

name: Copper Sword
desc: A good weapon for slaying foes.

name: Pipe Club
desc: A hefty pipe with a gauge on the end for added weight.

name: Iron Sword
desc: A strong weapon for slaying foes.

name: Galaxite Sword
desc: An otherworldly weapon for slaying foes.

name: Octarine Sword
desc: An extraordinary weapon for slaying foes.

name: Solarite Sword
desc: A superior weapon for obliterating foes.

name: Slippery Slime Sword
desc: A blue variant of the slime sword. It sometimes spreads slime onto your enemies that makes them slide around.

name: Crystal Shard Club
desc: This bludgeoning weapon is made from fragile crystal, that can send out splinters when swung.

name: Iron Halberd
desc: A luxurious pole-weapon fit for a royal guardian and perfect for poking at adversaries.

name: Tin Sword
desc: A sharp weapon for slaying foes.

name: Larva Spike Club
desc: A bludgeoning weapon that is hard to withstand.

name: Tentacle Whip
desc: An elastic tentacle that lashes out at enemies from afar. It's still alive and wiggling in your hand.

name: Scarlet Sword
desc: A great weapon for slaying foes.

name: Hydra Bone Sword
desc: A jagged sword made from a hydra's spine. It is not particularly sharp but its uneven shape can tear dangerous wounds into your opponents.

name: Octarine Axe
desc: This crescent-shaped weapon hits hard and magically arcs towards enemies' weak spots.

name: Battle Axe
desc: A menacing weapon that swings wide and hits hard.

name: Tin Axe
desc: A slower but more damaging weapon against multiple enemies.

name: Lava Battle Axe
desc: A smoldering, heavy weapon that looks like it was just taken out of the forge.

name: Anchor Axe
desc: This heavy weapon is actually just a ship anchor. Hits very hard and can throw enemies off.

name: Pandorium Axe
desc: This weapon has been designed by minds twisted in the darkness of The Passage. It tears more than it cuts.

name: Zealot's Scimitar
desc: A brilliant sword that channels mana into the blade to increase its power.

name: Slime Sword
desc: A strange weapon, good for damaging enemies and slowing them down.

name: Broken Handle
desc: A piece of an ancient weapon. Even though it's only the handle it already feels mysteriously balanced in your hand.

name: Noxious Meteor Staff
desc: A tainted staff laced with corroding blight. It sizzles with embittered energies that rain down a dense drop of toxin.

name: Corrupted Meteor Staff
desc: A weathered staff infused with cosmic corruption. It crackles with unfathomable energies and whispers of forbidden power.

name: Arcane Staff
desc: Unleash a torrent of arcane energies.

name: Chaos Staff
desc: An unpredictable, powerful weapon that weaves chaotic ancient energy into all kinds of projectiles. The enemy will never know what's coming for them.

name: Sun Caller
desc: Used by great mages to conjure small stars.

name: Stormbringer
desc: Augmented by a mysterious energy, this weapon unleashes chaining arcs of lightning upon your foes. Holding it sends a tingling sensation through your arms.

name: Fireball Staff
desc: A magical staff that the caveling shamans use in their rituals and against uninvited guests.

name: Simple Staff
desc: Commonly used by apprentice mages.

name: Scholar's Staff
desc: A magical staff wielded by caveling scholars that utilizes an ancient gemstone to produce powerful bolts of energy.

name: Scrap Minigun
desc: A gun-like apparatus that manages to convert disposable debris into a flurry of cutting missiles.

name: Obliteration Ray
desc: A high energy mining tool that is at the constant limit of bursting. The barely contained laser melts almost anything in its path.

name: Sticky Stick
desc: This staff is drenched in slime that never seems to end no matter how much is flung away.

name: Throwing Daggers
desc: A set of curved blades. They're evenly balanced so that throwing them is as easy as pointing a finger.

name: Galaxite Chakram
desc: This unique throwing weapon requires finesse and dexterity to be used to its full potential.

name: Blowpipe
desc: A simple weapon loaded with poisonous darts.

name: Iron Bow
desc: A sturdy bow to shoot foes from afar.

name: Bubble Gun
desc: A strange ranged weapon that shoots out hovering bubbles, adding slippery movement on contact.

name: Phantom Spark
desc: A legendary, masterfully crafted bow that shoots pure energy projectiles. Sometimes those pierce the veil of time and space, calling upon the spirits of the past.

name: Slingshot
desc: Simple ranged weapon to fire away at enemies.

name: Snowball
desc: A handy projectile to start some fights with the neighbours' children. Can also be collected and further processed.

name: Solarite Crossbow
desc: A grand glimmering crossbow that shoots mighty bolts.

name: Flintlock Musket
desc: Can't argue much with a handful of lead coming right at you.

name: Octarine Bow
desc: A strange bow that enhances the way arrows fly, allowing for quicker shots.

name: Flamethrower
desc: A bulky tank attached to a hose spraying ignited fuel, ready to set the world ablaze.

name: Quill Rifle
desc: A re-engineered bioweapon, discharging quills as deadly bolts.

name: Void Gun
desc: A particle weapon with unknown inner workings. It emits balls of void that distort spacetime to inflict high damage.

name: Wood Crossbow
desc: A small wooden crossbow that swiftly shoots bolts.

name: Scarlet Crossbow
desc: A heavy metallic crossbow that shoots potent bolts.

name: Wood Bow
desc: A crude bow to shoot foes from afar.

name: Ricochet Shuriken
desc: A four-bladed throwing weapon that bounces back and forth across the room. Slicing any enemy in its path.

name: Titan Breath
desc: Wrought by restrained paradox, it inhales energy to exhale a controlled cut through the aether. Anything trapped within is overwhelmed by the distilled entropy.

name: Burnzooka
desc: This fiery weapon was modeled after the grubzooka but enhanced with lava rock shielding to contain its power. Can blast away stone walls and anything weaker.

name: Grubzooka
desc: The heavy shots from the Grubzooka also tear down any dirt, sand and turf walls in its path.

name: Credence of Ruin
desc: A relic born of cult devotion and void corruption. Forged from S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s own frame and sanctified components of Breaker's Reach.

name: Volcano Mortar
desc: Erupts molten chunks into the air to crash like meteoroids.

name: Stone Mortar
desc: A handheld cannon hurling rocks into the air. They won't know what hit 'em!

name: Scrapzooka
desc: A weapon of scrap. Because some problems are best blasted away.

name: Bomb Scarab Mortar
desc: A powerful weapon launching explosive projectiles that resemble the center eye of a bomb scarab.

name: Cupid Bow
desc: A bow that hits right into the heart of its target and has a chance to infatuate it with the archer.

name: Wooden Sword
desc: A crude weapon to fend off foes.

name: Fire Grenade
desc: An explosive fit for those who want to set the world on fire!

name: Poison Grenade
desc: An explosive that is hard to recover from.

name: Grenade
desc: A throwable explosive that bounces on impact.

name: Stun Grenade
desc: Creates a blast that overwhelms the senses.

name: Charm Grenade
desc: Nothing is as persuasive as a little explosive charm.

name: Oil Grenade
desc: Splatters combustible oil all over the ground.

name: Blast Bundle
desc: Thrown much like a regular grenade... but creates a stronger blast!

name: Tome of the Dark
desc: More of a pamphlet, beginners guide to shadowmancy.

name: Tome of the Deep
desc: A tome that contains powerful incantions barely utterable by the human tongue.

name: Tome of the Dead
desc: A vile treatise on the conjuring of restless spirits.

name: Tome of Ashes
desc: Reeks of sulfur and is hot to the touch.

name: Tome of Sprouts
desc: A mystical tome germinating with verdant potential.

name: Tome of Decay
desc: Flipping through its pages causes your fingers to go numb.

name: Tome of Breach
desc: More of an unfinished journal detailing the author's obsession with unearthing secrets.
